newsitem.title: UK: UK insurers under pressure as Norwich float looms.
newsitem.headline: UK insurers under pressure as Norwich float looms.

text.p: Shares of composite insurers were under pressure on Wednesday as traders locked in profits ahead of the forthcoming Norwich Union flotation.
Institutional investors were also expected to shift some funds into the newest insurance stock, which is due to come to the market on June 16, dealers and analysts said.
"Insurers had a good run recently and it's time to take the profits. On the other hand the institutions will change their allocation", an analyst said.
Commercial Union Plc led the gainers in the sector, down 10p to 720-1/2 by 10.20 GMT while General Accident Plc lost 6-1/2p to 935.
General Accident has surged around 27 percent in the past six month while Commercial Union gained roughly 14 percent.
Elsewhere in the sector, Guardian Royal Exchange Plc was down 3-1/2p to 286-1/2 while Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group Plc fell 4p to 475-1/2.
